protocol.hypothesis: Add one legal combat move with lower maximum geometric secondary Chakram exposure than all ordinary retained pure moves and the pure-move incumbent. Preserve normal moves and let unchanged A19 rollout and arbitration choose.

source.overlay: Offline copied move catalog + bounded shortlist reservation. Native public Setup, seeded server identities, capsule-specific common package identity and independent opening reconstruction unchanged.

protocol.reference: Adopted contextual063a plus lockedV3 draft, authoritative fully funded rangedd786 setup, native formation/support splits and A19; actual full public ranked Setup
protocol.scope: Controlled physical team root only; no dominant-finish or urgent-finish expansion. Existing move guards remain. At most one extra legal move, one additional leaf, normal K, leading ordinary challenger preserved. Existing later specialized reservations remain. No changed rollout policy, horizon/count or fitted weights.
protocol.proposal: Canonical Chakram trajectory on detached grid with actor moved, never deleted. Rank maximum then total exp-times-alive secondary collateral, then original route order. Primary-shot legality and enemy choice are deliberately not predicted. Actual normal rollouts resolve terrain, LOS, attack damage, misses, initiative and other threats.
protocol.information: Only currently visible combat units, abilities, shots, footprint and board occupancy; no future actions, RNG draws, hidden identities or outcome labels.
protocol.population: Admission: first 27 already-opened development families, all four physical-seat/draft variants. Development: all 162 already-opened families. Three maps and all nine doctrine pairs; no creature/outcome selection. Reused development is not independent evidence.

preflight.controls: Independently reconstructed off/observer openings and exact full traces; exact replay against 108 prior corrected OFF receipts; identical package RNG and FightStateManager constructors; nine cold-process controls before development.
preflight.quality: zero rejects/censoring/model errors or missing neural starts; both A19 seats; original moves retained, bounded shortlist and top challenger preserved; helper exceptions cannot be swallowed by native search
preflight.admissionSemantics: Count only proposals surviving unchanged native guards. Vetoes are reported separately. Any admission or quality failure closes this candidate without expanding the smoke bank.

analysis.cluster: Whole offer board, both draft assignments and physical seats
analysis.exactTest: two-sided whole-family sign flip, integer deltas times8

futureRequirements.opponentPanel: Separate fixed contrasting controller/army panel after primary pass
futureRequirements.freshSeeds: Separate prospective registration and global exclusion audit before any fresh games; old banks closed

analysisCorrection.reason: Ordinary catalog deduplicates a Tsar Cannon move against its identical incumbent, retaining a differently ordered targetCells array. The original analyzer compared ordered arrays. The correction sorts only targetCells for the preservation assertion; paths, flags, unit ids and other fields still compare exactly.

flightDescription.interpretation: All completed development games, no outcome selection. Aggregate observed flight damage is affected by fight length, chosen targets, deaths and all later decisions; it is not a causal decomposition or a strength/promotion endpoint. Damage means engine-reported damage, not HP-clipped expected damage.

firstDifferenceDescription.description: All changed trajectories, without win/loss selection. Raw incumbent is not necessarily the full baseline search choice. This is descriptive evidence, not a causal strength decomposition.
